1. As per the guidance note issued by NSE, the Company do not have any regular chairperson, therefore, we have selected category 2 for Mr. Premchand Surana as Chairperson as he was elected as chairman of the last board meeting of the company held on 7th November, 2025.
2. In terms of Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, consent of members by way of special resolution for continuation of directorship of Independent Non-Executive Director, beyond the age of 75 years was taken on 20th August, 2025 for appointment of Mr. Jwalasingh Rajput for the term of 5 years effective from 27th May, 2025 and continuation of his directorship from the day he attains the age of 75 years till the expiry of his term. Currently he is aged 74 Years and during the tenure Mr. Jwalasingh Rajput will attain the age of 75 years.
